entries.0300045d75d610c7: Its mission is to “contribute to the improvement of product quality worldwide through unique image inspection technology and bring richness and happiness to people’s lives,” and its vision is to “develop the world’s number one image inspection system and aim for zero visual inspection in manufacturing sites.” Its medium-term management plan “SIRIUS2028” places at the core of its business strategy “exploration,” creating new businesses and products, and “deepening,” refining existing businesses and products.
entries.036f381b99d3858d: Sales of equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is printed as “－,” and there was no revenue for the current period.
entries.0ac6fe65df697fe8: A single segment for image inspection. The company develops and sells image inspection systems that automatically check the quality of printed matter, along with their peripheral equipment; designs and manufactures packaging software and related products; and provides cloud services using network devices. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,064 million.
entries.2453943cd6eae022: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,064 million. By product and service, image inspection accounted for ¥1,751 million, other for ¥309 million, and merchandise for ¥3 million; no figure was printed for equipment sales.

entries.4688106721ba9bab: Its strength lies in image inspection software technology accumulated since it began designing and developing image inspection machines in 2002, and in offering inspection software and inspection machines for multiple printing markets: label printing, gravure printing, and paper container and packaging printing.
entries.4bf53b4a694e5d9f: Sales of image inspection software and print quality inspection equipment equipped with such software. Products include print quality inspection software “AsmilVision,” high-speed wide-area inspection software “PolarVision,” gravure cylinder inspection equipment “GRACE,” print-start plate checking equipment “S-Scan-LNC” and compact tabletop inspection equipment “S-Comet.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,751 million.

entries.5e6ecce9dea3b21a: Founded in 1966 in Osaka as Ohira Kogyo Co., Ltd., a special printing machinery maker, the company changed its name to SiriusVision Co., Ltd. in 2021. Its head office is in Kohoku-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and as of December 31, 2025 it had 85 consolidated employees and formed a group with 5 consolidated subsidiaries.
